etymology.historical_story: A documented literary occurrence is Dejah Thoris, the princess of Helium in Edgar Rice Burroughs's Barsoom stories. The author's official character profile connects her with A Princess of Mars and later adventures. This establishes a cultural occurrence of the name, but does not establish its linguistic derivation or explain every independent use of Dejah. [Source](https://www.edgarriceburroughs.com/characters/dejahthoris/).
